run_mimic_joint_simulation: run the pybullet mimic joint constraint simulation with gear ratios between differential ring wheels
create_gear_constraint: create a gear joint constraint between two joints using pybullet createConstraint with JOINT_GEAR type
change_gear_ratio: change the gear ratio and max force on an existing constraint using pybullet changeConstraint
load_urdf_model: load a URDF model like diff_ring.urdf into the pybullet physics simulation environment
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control to velocity control mode with zero target velocity for all joints
